== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Displacement]].
* Since this spirit will usually die very quickly, it is best to use this skill before the fight starts so that when it actually does begin, this skill will be ready to use again.
* [[Shielding Urn]] from the [[Alliance Battle]]s in [[Saltspray Beach]] can take the damage taken by this spirit until it wears off.
{{anomaly|There is a delay of 2-3 seconds from the spirit's creation to its effect being applied, unlike other skills.}}
{{bug|The duration bar beneath the [[effects monitor]] [[skill icon]] does not shrink over time like other effects with durations.}}
